note: One row per line of the index files, in their order: probe, gallery, list, bozorth3 score. minutia_count is the number of lines mindtct wrote to each .xyt, carried because bozorth3 returns 0 both below its minminutiae floor and on an empty template, and a zero is otherwise indistinguishable from a non-match. stderr_by_row is whatever bozorth3 wrote to its error stream, by row, for the rows where it wrote anything; overflow_sentinel_rows lists rows whose score is the 4000 the tool returns on overflow.
